title: Create one 3x4 grid contact sheet, 12 pa
prompt:
Create one 3x4 grid contact sheet, 12 panels, same person, same outfit, same hairstyle, same soft studio light, plain light-grey seamless backdrop, full-body or three-quarter framing, 85mm photo look. Each panel shows one different pose listed below, natural and relaxed, real photography, not illustration. Add a small clean caption under each panel with the pose name. Keep face identity consistent across all 12 panels.
1 weight on back leg, hip shifted
2 hand tucking hair behind ear, looking down
3 over-the-shoulder glance
4 sitting on floor, knees up, arms wrapped
5 leaning shoulder on wall
6 hands in pockets, mid-step walk
7 chin resting on hand
8 looking up at light, eyes half closed
9 turning away, back three-quarters
10 crossed arms, slight head tilt
11 adjusting sleeve cuff
12 laughing, body bent slightly forward
